title: Act: Add execution action handlers to AdminApp
summary: Import client functions, add runExecutionAction, pass handlers.
description: Edit AdminApp.tsx to import approveExecution, rejectExecution, retryExecution, add runExecutionAction and pass onApprove, onRetry, onReject to ExecutionPanel.
acceptance_criteria: AdminApp compiles with the three handlers passed
Each handler calls its client function with token and id then bumps reloads

steps.action: Add approveExecution, rejectExecution and retryExecution to the named import list from '../api/client'.
steps.code:
ApiError,
  approveExecution,
  closeRound,
  ...
  openRound,
  rejectExecution,
  retryExecution,
steps.expected: The three client functions are imported once each.

steps.action: Add an async function runExecutionAction(action: RoundAction-like (token, id) => Promise<ExecutionInfo>, id: string) that awaits action(token, id) then calls setReloads((n) => n + 1) inside a try block; the catch block is added by the error requirement.
steps.expected: Calling it POSTs then triggers a refetch.

steps.action: Pass onApprove, onRetry and onReject props to ExecutionPanel, each calling runExecutionAction with the matching client function and the id argument.
steps.code: <ExecutionPanel execution={execution} contributionCount={contributions.length} onApprove={(id) => runExecutionAction(approveExecution, id)} onRetry={(id) => runExecutionAction(retryExecution, id)} onReject={(id) => runExecutionAction(rejectExecution, id)} />
steps.expected: Approve, Retry and Reject buttons appear for matching statuses and are wired.
